title: Convenient Horses with MCM patch for SeverActions
tagline: Convenient Horses with MCM for SeverActions by Andy_A
description:
A patch thatb allows Convenient Horses to discover actors on SeverActions' live follower
roster, including Tracking-mode and custom-framework followers that deliberately
do not belong to Skyrim's CurrentFollowerFaction. Load after Convenient Horses with MCM and allow to overwrite. WILL NOT WORK FOR REGULAR CONVENIENT HORSES OR ANY OTHER FOLLOWER FRAMEWORK. Refer to CONVENIENT HORSES With MCM at Skyrim Special Edition Nexus - Mods and Community for Convenient Horses with MCM for all use of that mod information. 

Credit to the OG author michalek, of Convenient Horses and to davidg53 for the port of that to Convenient Horses with MCM
